Name: Gregory of Nyssa
Summary: Bishop of Nyssa in Cappadocia in the fourth century, younger brother of Basil of Caesarea and a profound mystical and doctrinal theologian.
Contribution: His writings on the Trinity, the Christian life as unending growth toward God, and the interpretation of Scripture deepened Eastern theology, and his account of his sister Macrina preserved one of the early church's most remarkable spiritual biographies.
KeyWorks: Life of Moses; On the Making of Man; Great Catechetical Oration
